request.name: Place an order from the cart

description.content: Turns the signed-in customer's whole cart into one order at the cart's store, in one transaction, and empties the cart. The address must be one of the customer's own, its pincode must be served by the cart's store, the store must be open, and the subtotal must reach the store's minimum order. Every cart line must be in stock: placement takes the stock, and a line whose product is inactive or short of stock refuses the whole order and names every such product. The subtotal is each line's current price times its quantity; the delivery fee is the store's, or 0 at or above its free-delivery amount. The order keeps snapshots of the address, the customer's name and phone, and each item's name, unit label, image, price and MRP. Answers 201 with the order, status placed. A refused placement changes nothing: the cart and the stock stay as they were. Errors: 400 validation with no field when the cart is empty; 400 naming addressId when it is missing (required), not a uuid (must be a uuid) or not the customer's (unknown address); 400 naming subtotal when it is below the store's minimum order; 401 with no token, an unknown token or a staff token; 409 not_serviceable naming addressId when the store does not deliver to the address, and 409 not_serviceable with no field when the store is closed; 409 out_of_stock with productIds; 409 conflict when the order number collides, which is rare, and the client may retry.
